text: Your best posture is your next posture. A 90-second shift changes how your whole afternoon feels.
Consistency beats intensity every single time. Two gentle minutes today is a real win.
Unclench your jaw, drop your shoulders an inch, and take one slow breath. You just started.
Movement doesn't have to be a 60-minute gym session. Caring for your joints at your desk counts.
Stiffness likes stillness. Give your spine a soft wave and let circulation do the rest.
Rest days and gentle days are part of the rhythm, not a break from it.
Every glass of water and 2-minute stretch is a thank-you note to your future self.
